```plato

    //==
    // # ColorGradient
    //
    // Sampling a stop list. Stops are assumed ordered by Position; a parameter
    // before the first stop or after the last takes that stop's colour (clamped
    // ends, not wrapped), and two stops at the same position make a hard edge
    // rather than a division by zero.

    // The index of the last stop at or before the parameter, or 0 when the
    // parameter precedes every stop.
    StopIndexAt(self: ColorGradient, t: Number): Integer
        => self.Stops.Count.Range.Reduce(0, (acc, i) => self.Stops[i].Position <= t ? i : acc);
```
